mainEntity.name: How long does the ADU architectural planning phase typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The architectural planning phase for an ADU typically takes 6-12 weeks, depending on the project's complexity and how quickly decisions are made. This includes initial consultations, design development, client revisions, and preparing permit-ready documents. Variations in site conditions or specific aesthetic requirements can extend this timeline, so it's helpful to have a clear vision for your ADU before starting design.
